_warning: TEMPLATE ONLY. Every box below is a placeholder, not a measured BGMI HUD position. Organiser overlays move the HUD, so run 'bgmi-scrim calibrate <video> --out myprofile.json' on your own footage and verify with 'calibrate <video> --preview myprofile.json'. Set _calibrated to true once every ROI reads correctly in the preview.

_calibration_notes.teams_alive/players_alive: Box the digits only, not the label or icon. Set digits to the maximum digit count (2 for teams, 3 for players) and min/max to the plausible range.
_calibration_notes.team_panel: Box the panel with its top-left at the first row. row_pitch is the vertical distance between two rows in pixels; slot_x0/slot_pitch/slot_w/slot_h locate the four player indicators inside a row; tag_x/tag_w/tag_h locate the team tag text. Check with --preview: every green box must sit on one player indicator.
_calibration_notes.kill_feed: Box the TOP feed row only; rows/row_pitch/row_h generate the rest.
_calibration_notes.slot_states/zone_states: HSV bands for the overlay's colours. Sample them from a frame (OpenCV HSV: H 0-179, S/V 0-255) and widen until classification is stable. min_fraction is how much of the patch must fall in the band.
_calibration_notes.team_tags: The lobby roster. Tags are matched to this list, so a tag that is missing here will not be read.
_calibration_notes.reset_at: A counter jumping back up to at least this value is treated as a new match in the same recording.
